column1: # Goma Cave Entrance — Ivan rejoins Isaac and Garet after Vault
# IDs 05008-05024, contiguous event triggered by Move on the ivy-bound stump after the thieves are jailed.

column3: You need that stump\nmoved, don't you?{end_wait}
Those vines are holding\nit in place.{end_wait}
Move won't help while\nthose vines hold it.{end_wait}
I can clear those vines.\nStand back a little.{end_wait}
I tried. But I couldn't\nget past the gates.{end_wait}
I still have to find\nMaster Hammet. I haven't\nforgotten him.{end_wait}
But I've been thinking\nabout what I learned\nback in Vault.{end_wait}
When I read your mind,\nI saw what happened\nat Sol Sanctum.{end_wait}
Jenna and Kraden are\nstill out there.\nI can't ignore that.{end_wait}
The Elemental Stars\nhave to be recovered.\nI want to help.{end_wait}
If you'll have me,\nI'd like to come along.{end_wait}
You're going through\nGoma Cave to Bilibin,\naren't you?{end_wait}
